newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian Uhispank seeks issue approval.
newsitem.headline: Estonian Uhispank seeks issue approval.

text.p: One of the largest Estonian commercial banks, Eesti Uhispank, is to ask its shareholders for approval to make a new issue of shares.
At an October 10 meeting, shareholders will be asked to back an issue of 1.9 million preference shares for employees and 9.4 million preference shares for shareholders, both at 13 kroons.
The preference shares will be exchanged later this year for ordinary shares, the bank said in a statement.
Uhispank, which has a quote in Tallinn and Helsinki, is Estonia's third largest bank and made a net profit in 1995 of 35 million kroons. It has assets of 2.6 billion kroons.
